pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and irregularly shaped dark brown regions with variable spatial area. Edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients and soft transitions into the lighter network.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways separating the darker patches. Intersections form distinct junction nodes. The thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform and narrow across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the dorsal ridge of the neck and shoulder, indicating a short, continuous mane profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the mid-lateral flank.
